expected_differences: The real account uses the name demo-creator and a D initial rather than Maya’s fixture portrait and identity.

Available $34.00, Pending $0.00 and Lifetime $34.00 correctly replace the Lab’s fixture amounts. Request payout reflects the visible production state; the Lab’s requested $50.00 payout should not be copied.
The single real Recreate transaction retains its source thumbnail, record title, September 9 date and Available status. Its $40.00 gross amount less the $6.00 fee reconciles to the +$34.00 credit.
Messages and Notifications show actual unread counts. The sparse transaction list does not need invented records or replacement media.
keep: Mineral #F4F3EF canvas, graphite #101820 navigation and ordinary ink financial values, without floating cards, shadows or decorative containers.
The desktop balance-and-payout column on the left and transaction ledger on the right, with a 32px content inset from the 200px rail.
Strong money hierarchy: the approximately 56/60px available balance dominates, while Pending and Lifetime remain separate, unboxed values with explicit meanings.
The cobalt Request payout decision, 8px control corners and generous target height. The fee and manual-payout explanation remain visible beside the action.
The compact real transaction source, readable literal status, gross/fee explanation and right-aligned signed credit.
The restrained TapMart mark, selected Earnings edge and visible account, Home, Activity, Profile, Search, Messages and Notifications controls.
review.readiness_note: Sign off on the captured 1440×900 presentation; the unread-badge accent adjustment is non-blocking polish. The capture exposes the balance, payout action, transaction and navigation, but cannot verify payout submission, account switching, destination behavior or loading/error states.

drift.change: Change the unread-count badge backgrounds from cobalt to #1D2833 and retain #F6F8FB count text. Preserve their current 20px size, counts and navigation bindings. Keep #2450E8 on Request payout and the selected Earnings edge.
drift.why: Unread counts are informational, not commitments or selected states. Their two additional cobalt spots slightly dilute the approved decision-focused accent hierarchy.
drift.where: Desktop rail: Messages and Notifications count badges

review.why: This correctly translates the system rather than copying the phone Profile composition. The mineral field, graphite identity/navigation region, strong typography and unboxed financial layout match Frame Shift’s working language. Available, Pending and Lifetime are not conflated, and nothing implies that a payout has already been sent. The transaction is a historical ledger entry rather than a source-inspection-to-commitment assembly, so it does not need an artificial 24px notch. The real source remains visible without becoming a hero. No clipping, overlap or obstructed control is visible at this viewport.
review.verdict: Yes—the captured desktop Earnings screen faithfully transfers Frame Shift and preserves the visible financial functionality, with one minor, non-blocking accent correction.
